turns.text: You keep the records of the Ashfall Botanic Garden. Enter three facts: the glasshouse orchid is watered every 9 days; the rose garden is mulched each April; the head gardener is named Iris Veld. Confirm in one line.
A volunteer asks, and no ledger is at hand: how many days pass between two waterings of the glasshouse orchid? Reply with just the number.
